summary: All five round 1 findings are closed against the amended spec.md and plan.md. No blocked or Major gap remains in the changed lines, so the gate passes. One nonblocking, pre-existing gap stays: the T8 done-when checks a MANIFEST.sha256 file that no phase creates.
nonblocking_findings: F6 [Major] plan.md Phase 5 T8 done-when: The command `sha256sum -c out/apk-audio-handoff/chibi/MANIFEST.sha256` names a file that AC6 and T8 never create; AC6 lists only 14 sound files, MANIFEST.tsv, and README.md in the folder. Rationale: This is a pre-existing gap outside the lines the amendment changed, so it is nonblocking in this re-review. The archive pattern uses `grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{64}  ' MANIFEST.txt | sha256sum -c -`, which works on a manifest column; name that command or add the file to AC6 so Green can make the done-when pass.

paraphrase.proposes: The track maps the 58 game effect names to the seven earshot set entries or to synth. It adds an MP3 copy of each Ogg through a pinned ffmpeg command and picks Ogg or MP3 once per browser with canPlayType. The AudioBus plays a file when one is decoded and falls back to the synth recipe on a missing mapping or a failed load. A preload budget and a manifest hand-off folder send the files to the PM for the monorepo; the target path is marked proposed until the PM or Monorepo session confirms it. Credits stay deferred, the moods stay synthesized, and story audio stays out of scope.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, each game names its effects and the AudioBus builds every effect from tones and noise, so no game sound effect loads from a file today. The sound-set wrapper renders seven Ogg files from sounds/sets/chibi.json into sounds/chibi/, and the files total 90,468 bytes. The bus synthesizes all 26 moods; story player MP3 files exist in demo/public/stories and are not game effects. The hand-off folder and MP3 copy do not exist yet.
